title: Benchmark and select the candidate strategy

artifacts.grain: one evaluation run, strategy plan and configured k cutoff

measures: reviewed species candidate recall at k
reviewed family candidate recall at k
complete candidate-set size and evaluated prefix size
measured dot products and reference members
measured elapsed time and peak memory
cache-reused and newly loaded reference members with reuse fraction
metrics_contract.measurement_boundary: Performance fields require supplied instrumentation rows; missing or inconsistent time, memory, work or cache evidence fails validation rather than being estimated.

family_pruning_contract.denominator: reviewed correct species present in the immutable complete candidate union
family_pruning_contract.exclusion: reviewed species absent from the complete union are reported separately and are not attributed to family pruning

required_evidence: all three strategies on identical labelled candidate sets
configured overall target, species and family recall thresholds
configured no-geo and wrong-family recall thresholds with non-empty slices
observed recall non-inferiority to the best evaluated strategy
configured dot-product, reference-member, elapsed-time and peak-memory ceilings
selection_contract.production_default_mutation: never performed by the ablation report

fixture_ablation.evidence_class: deterministic implementation fixture; not production validation
fixture_ablation.interpretation: The fixture demonstrates metric, counterfactual and fail-closed selection behavior. Its strategy values are not live performance estimates and cannot select a production strategy.

strategy_evaluation_suite.command: uv run pytest -q tests/test_candidate_strategy_metrics.py tests/test_candidate_strategy_ablation.py tests/test_family_geo_candidates.py tests/test_evaluation_metrics.py tests/test_target_verification_metrics.py tests/test_target_aware_scoring.py tests/test_target_aware_fusion.py tests/test_target_aware_output.py tests/test_bioclip_classification_modes.py tests/test_current_reference_pooling_audit.py

githits_architecture_impact.availability: The user prohibited further GitHits calls for the remainder of the goal after repeated unavailability.
first_party_basis: BioMiner reviewed-label and deterministic metric conventions
BioMiner semantic fingerprint and fail-closed release conventions
githits_architecture_impact.assessment: The user directive removed GitHits from Task 4.2. Four explicit skipped_user_directive records preserve process transparency; no repositories, solutions, findings, code, prose or architecture are attributed to GitHits.

selection_state.reason: Only deterministic implementation-fixture evidence was run. The configured gate correctly failed its non-fixture-evidence check.

allowed: Task 4.2 implements deterministic, label-bound strategy metrics for every requested recall and resource dimension.
The family-pruning counterfactual uses an explicit eligible denominator and does not mutate candidate membership.
The selection report fails closed on fixture evidence and never changes the production default.
The full software regression and repository-wide lint gates pass.
blocked: The fixture establishes live candidate recall, throughput, memory or cache performance.
The parallel strategy or any other strategy is empirically or universally superior.
A strategy has been selected or made default for production.
Family or geography evidence proves taxonomic identity or absence.
Dynamic pools, calibration, statistical support, human verification, occurrence release or production deployment are complete.
